Hi Elena — thanks again for a productive conversation today. Quick recap from our side and three asks to help move this along:

Summary of call:
- Goal: Replace legacy hosted LLM endpoints used for clinical-document summarization with a production-inference setup that lowers per-token cost and guarantees 99.9% availability for business-critical queues.
- Key decision criteria you mentioned: latency for short responses (<150ms p50), data residency in US, SOC2 evidence, and predictable monthly spend.
- High-level technical fit: Redwood hosted with private VPC option looks like a good starting point; we discussed Dedicated capacity for predictable throughput and a pilot on 2 GPU nodes.

Asks / next steps:
1) Can you confirm the economic buyer and final approver for procurement (name + title)?
2) Please share the vendor onboarding checklist owner or the procurement inbox so we can send the security questionnaire and a draft SOW.
3) Confirm an ideal PO timeline (e.g., PO issued by end of July?) and any fiscal constraints.

I attached a short SOW draft and the vendor questionnaire for reference (attachment: Redwood_Demo_SOW_v0.2.pdf, vendor_questionnaire_novasure.xlsx). If you prefer, I can send the questionnaire directly to procurement.

Proposed immediate milestone: internal pilot kickoff week of July 20th assuming PO by July 31st. If procurement needs longer lead time we can propose a short evaluation contract with a credit-backed invoice.

Thanks — happy to hop on a quick follow-up if that helps.

Best,
Karthik
